info.name: Get department details by department IDs

params.name: departmentIds
params.description: Comma-separated array of department IDs. Maximum number of IDs allowed is 50.

items.docs: This API fetches the details of the departments whose IDs are passed in the API request.

params.name: fieldName
params.description: Name of the field that must be used for searching and listing agents. Values allowed are: @firstName@, @lastName@, @name@, and @emailId@.

params.name: searchStr
params.description: String to search for agents by first name, last name, or email ID. The string must contain at least one character. Three search methods are supported: 1) string* - Searches for agents whose first name, last name, or email ID start with the string, 2) *string* - Searches for agents whose first name, last name, or email ID contain the string, 3) string - Searches for agents whose first name, last name, or email ID is an exact match for the string

params.name: isLightAgent
params.description: Key that denotes if the agents must be light or non light.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: To sort the available list of agents in either ascending or descending order. Values allowed are: @asc@ or @desc@

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of agents to fetch; default value is 10 and maximum value is 200

params.name: from
params.description: Index number, starting from which the agents must be listed

params.name: isConfirmed
params.description: Key that denotes if the agents must be confirmed or unconfirmed.

params.name: status
params.description: Key that filters agents, based on their activation status: @ACTIVE@ or @DISABLED@

params.name: chatStatus
params.description: Key that filters departments based on their chat status. Values allowed are @AVAILABLE@, @DISABLED@, @NOT_CREATED@, and @${UNAVAILABLE}@. @${UNAVAILABLE}@ refers to departments which are not available for chat.

params.name: searchStr

Three search methods are supported: 1) string* - Searches for agents whose first name, last name, or email ID start with the string, 2) *string* - Searches for agents whose first name, last name, or email ID contain the string, 3) string - Searches for agents whose first name, last name, or email ID is an exact match for the string

params.name: isEnabled
params.description: Key that filters departments based on their enabled status
